manual_contract_review: The active callback binds the original pre-consumption decision receipt to its authenticated consumed-operation record.
Support is passed through the run-local support_check parameter, retaining the existing executor qualification callback.

Commercial authorization checks exact authorized transition/history/current signer and operation binding. It intentionally does not turn the consumed transition command deadline into an Offering lease; the contract defines no such lease.
limitations: Independent narrow synthetic runtime probes only; the root owns the wider 76-case/full-native qualification.
Operation-map substitution probes use the fixture journal custodian to append authenticated adverse records; they do not establish that an untrusted caller can write such records.

No application source/root-owned file edit, held node/helper execution, frozen canary, live model, ENS/wallet action, customer action, credential creation, release or remote write. Probe instrumentation was process-local and restored by pytest; production qualification callbacks were not replaced by the repair.
No blanket concurrency guarantee for arbitrary shared mutable transports/environments, and no general security, profitability or release claim.
